announcement.title: A New Era for Simulator Station
announcement.body: Welcome to the ultimate flight simulation experience! We've completely rebuilt the app with a stunning Dark EFB UI, AI-powered NOTAMs, interactive Virtual Crew, precision Performance Calculators, and next-gen 3D Globe maps. Your cockpit is ready.

promo_banner.title: New feature
promo_banner.body: Experience ultimate realism: Head Tracking via camera is now live on Simulator Station.
